entries.t: <FACE:5F>The Cluster is made up<NL>of many Blocks.<WAIT>A control unit in each<NL>Block manages it.<WAIT>Every computer runs<NL>the newest, best<WAIT>system, built on what<NL>Robattle Research<WAIT>learned from studying<NL>Medals.<WAIT>All computers link to<NL>the Computer Block<WAIT>at the center, which<NL>runs the whole thing.<WAIT>The system running it<NL>all is called "Navi"<WAIT>Robattle Research put<NL>all it had into it,<WAIT>the biggest parallel<NL>system of its kind.<WAIT>If one part goes down,<NL>the rest take over.<WAIT>Thanks to this system,<NL>the Cluster's control<WAIT>is always kept in<NL>perfect condition.<WAIT>A computer going wild,<NL>like in sci-fi manga,<WAIT>is simply impossible.<WAIT>Ahead of humanity's<NL>move into space,<WAIT>total computer control<NL>of living space.<WAIT>That is one of the<NL>Cluster's themes.
<FACE:5F>Follow the Blocks from<NL>here all the way up<WAIT>and you'll reach the<NL>thruster control room
<FACE:47>So many kinds of<NL>Blocks! I can't wait!
<FACE:60>That space Medabot is<NL>in the Lobby Block
<FACE:5F>Each Block has its own<NL>control unit<WAIT>and its own separate<NL>environment
<FACE:5F>…So all our guests may<NL>just walk right in…
<FACE:22>No, that's not it…<NL><WAIT>You see, I'm the class<NL>president…<WAIT>So I must properly go<NL>in at the front…
